title: Heavy Transport & Vehicle Access Protocol
section: Section 1: Site Access, Vehicle Traffic & Heavy Transport
summary: Trucks entering site must keep to 15 km/h limit, deploy wheel chocks, and maintain 3.0m buffer from ground personnel.

title: Forklift & Mobile Equipment Movement in Field Yards
section: Section 1: Site Access, Vehicle Traffic & Heavy Transport
summary: Mandatory 2.5m separation between yard forklifts and pedestrian personnel; horns required at blind entries.

title: Machinery Safety Guarding & Exclusion Perimeters
section: Section 2: Industrial Machinery & Operating Perimeters
summary: Industrial machinery must maintain physical guard perimeters. Personnel must not enter machinery zones without LOTO permit.

title: Ground Hazards & Work Obstacles Demarcation
section: Section 2: Industrial Machinery & Operating Perimeters
summary: Temporary obstacles and trenches in transit paths must be cordoned off with at least two safety cones.

title: Site Head Protection (Safety Helmet Mandate)
section: Section 3: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for Field Sites
summary: Mandatory approved safety helmet for every person on active site, yard, or construction perimeter (ANSI Z89.1).

title: High-Visibility Clothing in Active Yards
section: Section 3: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for Field Sites
summary: Mandatory EN ISO 20471 Class 2 high-vis vest in outdoor yards and traffic zones at all times.

title: Mandatory Safety Signage Display
section: Section 4: Site Signage, Warnings & Evacuation Routes
summary: Site safety warning signage must be mounted at eye level, clean, and legible from at least 5 meters.

title: Emergency Exit & Gate Signage
section: Section 4: Site Signage, Warnings & Evacuation Routes
summary: Emergency exit gates must display exit signs and maintain 2.0m clear buffer free of obstacles and vehicles.

title: Site Fire Extinguisher Points
section: Section 5: Outdoor Fire Suppression & Chemical Hazards
summary: Site extinguisher stands must have 1.0m radial clearance free of obstacles and valid annual inspection tags.

title: Site Fire Hose Stations
section: Section 5: Outdoor Fire Suppression & Chemical Hazards
summary: External fire hydrant pillars and hose reel stations require a 1.5-meter unobstructed approach zone.

title: Uncontrolled Fire & Combustion Emergency
section: Section 5: Outdoor Fire Suppression & Chemical Hazards
summary: Immediate Level 1 Emergency. Detection of active fire triggers automatic alarms, gate release, and evacuation.

title: Field Spill Management & Caution Cones
section: Section 5: Outdoor Fire Suppression & Chemical Hazards
summary: Fuel, oil, or chemical spills > 0.5L must be cordoned off with at least two safety cones within 15 minutes.

title: Forklift Safe Operating Distance & Pedestrian Separation
section: Section 1: Forklift Traffic, Aisle Protocols & Pedestrians
summary: Minimum 2.5m (8-ft) separation distance mandatory between operating forklifts and pedestrian workers in warehouses.

title: High-Visibility Apparel in Warehouse Transit Aisles
section: Section 1: Forklift Traffic, Aisle Protocols & Pedestrians
summary: Warehouse operatives working in or crossing transit aisles must wear certified safety vests.

title: Primary Walkway Minimum Clearance
section: Section 2: Pallet Handling, Racking Integrity & Aisle Clearance
summary: Pedestrian walkways must maintain a continuous minimum unobstructed clearance width of 1.2 meters (4 feet).

title: Pallet Stacking Height & Shrink-Wrap Stability
section: Section 2: Pallet Handling, Racking Integrity & Aisle Clearance
summary: Freestanding pallet stacks must not exceed 2.4 meters (8 feet) or 3 unit tiers. Must be shrink-wrapped with max 5° lean.

title: Emergency Fire Exit Zero-Tolerance Clearance
section: Section 2: Pallet Handling, Racking Integrity & Aisle Clearance
summary: Zero tolerance: Pallets, cartons, carts, or obstacles within 2.0m of emergency exit doors are strictly forbidden.

title: Shelf Stocking Compliance & Empty Shelf Rectification
section: Section 3: Inventory Monitoring & Shelf Stocking (Retail / DC)
summary: Empty shelf space must not exceed 15% of bay area during operating hours. Replenish detected empty shelves within 2 hours.

title: Fire Extinguisher Accessibility & Radial Clearance
section: Section 4: Warehouse Fire Suppression & Life-Safety Systems
summary: Minimum 1.0m radial clearance around fire extinguishers must be kept clear of pallet stacks, boxes, and obstacles.

title: Fire Hose Reel Station Unobstructed Access
section: Section 4: Warehouse Fire Suppression & Life-Safety Systems
summary: Clear perimeter of 1.5m x 1.5m directly in front of each warehouse fire hose reel cabinet is mandatory.

title: Indoor Active Fire & Smoke Suppression Protocol
section: Section 4: Warehouse Fire Suppression & Life-Safety Systems
summary: Immediate catastrophic emergency. Detection of active fire triggers immediate automated alarms and evacuation.

title: Liquid Spill Containment Protocol
section: Section 5: Housekeeping, Spills & Hazard Demarcation
summary: Spills exceeding 0.5L must be cordoned off with safety cones within 15 minutes and absorbed until dry.

title: Mandatory Safety Cone Placement for Floor Hazards
section: Section 5: Housekeeping, Spills & Hazard Demarcation
summary: At least two high-visibility safety cones must be deployed around any wet floor or active floor repair.

title: Warehouse Floor Head Protection
section: Section 6: Warehouse PPE Compliance
summary: Mandatory approved safety helmets for all workers in warehouse storage floors, picking bays, and packing areas.

title: Illuminated Exit Signage Integrity
section: Section 7: Warehouse Signage & Directional Indicators
summary: ISO 7010 green running-man exit signs must remain illuminated 24/7 with zero blockage from pallet racks.

title: Facility Safety & Warning Signage Display
section: Section 7: Warehouse Signage & Directional Indicators
summary: Warning signage (forklift crossing, load limits, walkway markings) must be mounted at every aisle entrance.

title: Remediation Ticket Generation & Approval Gate
section: Section 8: Automated Compliance Ticketing & Approval Gate
summary: Critical/High failures automatically propose remediation tickets; held in proposed status awaiting manager UI approval.
